title: Haulnet community server
description: One file per server: servers/<region>/<city>-<number>.json. The display name '<Region> [<City>] #<number>' is derived from these fields; do not add it.

number.description: Server number within the city. A new server takes the smallest number not used in its city.

host.description: Public DNS name (lowercase) or public IPv4/IPv6 address, without port or brackets.

port.description: UDP port of the server's NameServer.

status_port.description: TCP port of the haulnet-server status endpoint (GET /status). Default 27080; set it only if you changed STATUS_ADDRESS.

name.description: Person or team running the server, shown to players.

github.description: GitHub account responsible for the server.

contact.description: Optional public contact: an https:// link or a mailto: address.
